label: Altissimo Cover Letter
subject: Application — Principal Mechanical Design Engineer
paragraphs: I'm a Mechatronics Engineer with a Masters Degree in Biomedical Engineering, a Diploma in Software Development, and over eight years of hands-on mechanical product-development experience across R&D, orthopaedic, and consulting environments. My work spans complex implant systems, prosthetics, surgical tools, integrated medical platforms, and custom manufacturing equipment, with experience taking designs from concept through modelling, prototyping, testing, integration, and regulatory readiness.

Across recent roles, I have applied material selection, design for manufacturing, supplier collaboration, quality-system controls, and compliance review to complex mechanical products. I balance functional performance, manufacturability, integration, and regulatory requirements through hands-on SOLIDWORKS modelling, detailed design, prototyping, tolerance analysis, design review, and technical problem-solving.

I am interested in bringing this hands-on design leadership to Altissimo Consultancy's Principal Mechanical Design Engineer opportunity, particularly the delivery of complex, customised machinery projects and collaboration with customers, suppliers, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and commercial teams. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss the relevance of my SOLIDWORKS, mechanical integration, manufacturing, and cross-functional project-delivery experience.
